desc:
🚢 Welcome to Cruise [Story]! The Carnival Cruise is the biggest and most luxurious CRUISE ever seen in Roblox! Up to 14 brave adventurers get a FREE TICKET and board this ship in seek of the best vacations of their life! But what happens when the best vacations turn into the worst..? Only the sea knows the answer.

🔥 Having a hard time surviving? Check out the GAMEPASSES we have to give you a hand!

😎 Join the fan group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/5103418/Ponchokings#!/about 

👍 If you enjoyed the game remember to like and favorite!
